column5: mô tả (vật thể: nhìn THẲNG chính diện như nhà vùng 1; tấm: 9 món 3×3 trên nền magenta)

a small swamp village house built on wooden stilts above murky water, walls of woven reeds and dark planks, steep thatched reed roof, little ladder to the door, hanging lantern and drying fish, straight front view
a round swamp healer hut on stilts, mossy thatched dome roof, herbs and gourds hanging from the eaves, wooden plank porch with jars of medicine, glowing green lantern, straight front view
a tall rickety wooden watchtower on stilts in a swamp, reed thatched roof, rope ladder, signal horn and a tattered grey banner, straight front view
a gnarled swamp cypress tree with twisted roots rising out of the mud, drooping grey-green hanging moss on its branches, dark olive leaves, straight front view

clump of tall swamp reeds, cattails with brown heads, cluster of green lily pads with a pink lotus, mossy fallen log, murky mud puddle, cluster of pale swamp mushrooms, rotten mossy tree stump, bush with drooping hanging moss, small sunken rowboat

short wooden plank walkway segment on posts, wooden mooring post with rope, fish drying rack, clay storage pot, lantern hanging on a pole, swamp wooden signpost, small wooden canoe, basket of herbs, stack of bundled reeds

broken mossy stone pillar, half-sunken ancient stone altar, pile of old bones, glowing blue swamp flower, cracked serpent statue head, toppled stone column with vines, poison green bubbling puddle, skull on a stake, twisted dead swamp tree
a sandstone desert house with a white plaster dome, arched wooden door, colorful striped awning, blue mosaic trim, clay pots by the door, straight front view
a desert bazaar merchant tent with striped red and gold fabric canopy on poles, rugs and jars of spices displayed under it, hanging brass lamps, straight front view
a grand sandstone oasis city gate with an arched entrance, two towers with onion domes, blue and gold banners, carved sun emblem above the arch, straight front view
a tall desert date palm tree with a curved ringed trunk, lush green fronds and clusters of orange dates, straight front view

tall green saguaro cactus, round prickly pear cactus with pink flowers, dry desert shrub, red sandstone rock, bleached animal skull, small sand dune mound, desert agave plant, cracked dry earth patch, red rock spire

tall clay amphora jars, rolled carpet stall, stone oasis well with a bucket, colorful banner on a pole, wooden crates of fruit, brass lantern, woven basket of spices, small date palm in a pot, camel saddle on a rack

golden pharaoh sarcophagus, sandstone obelisk with hieroglyphs, broken sphinx statue, carved hieroglyph pillar, half-buried clay urn, ancient stone tablet, toppled statue head, scarab beetle carving on a block, torch on a stone stand
a tall highland windmill of grey stone with a wooden cap and four large cloth sails, small door and window, straight front view
a sturdy highland stone cottage with a green turf grass roof, round wooden door, chimney with smoke, flower boxes, prayer flags strung from the roof, straight front view
a white marble cloud temple shrine gate with slender pillars and a curved roof, wind chimes hanging, swirling cloud carvings, small floating stones around it, straight front view
a windswept highland pine tree bent sideways by strong wind, dark green needles, twisted trunk on a mossy rock, straight front view
clump of tall swaying grass, wind-bent shrub, mossy grey boulder, patch of white and purple highland flowers, small fern, stack of flat stones cairn, heather bush, dry tumbleweed, lichen covered rock
